source.title: Composer ™ for Harmony Function Code Application Manual Volume 1 (Function Codes 1 to 174)

name: Slave Select
description: The slave select function code monitors a pair of redundant I/ O module function blocks. Specification S9 is a toggle input that switches from one module to the other when both modules are good. The block has two outputs, select (N) and interlock (N+1). The select output identifies the active module, and the interlock indicates when both modules are bad.
